# unifi_network_references (Data Source)

Reports the resources referencing a network (clients, devices, routes, WiFi, NAT rules, ...) via the UniFi **Official API** (`integration/v1`). Read-only. Requires a controller running version 10.1.78 or later with API-key authentication.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Report the resources referencing a network (clients, devices, WiFi, ...).
data "unifi_network_references" "lan" {
  network_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) The UUID of the network whose references to fetch.

### Optional

- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site to query. If not specified, the provider's default site is used.

### Read-Only

- `json` (String) The full network-references record serialized as a JSON string.
- `reference_resources` (Attributes List) The resource types referencing the network, grouped by type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reference_resources))

<a id="nestedatt--reference_resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reference_resources`

Read-Only:

- `reference_count` (Number) The number of references of this resource type.
- `reference_ids` (List of String) The UUIDs of the referencing resources, when enumerated by the controller.
- `resource_type` (String) The referencing resource type (e.g. `CLIENT`, `DEVICE`, `WIFI`, `NAT_RULE`).
